items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: he’s on the thing with Dizzy and Sonny Stitt and Sonny Rollins

ctx.x: Didn’t your brother go on to play with a number of people, including the Ink Spots and —

Yeah he did things like that. And he’s on quite a few of my recordings of course, the trio things, the early trio things, and he’s on the thing with Dizzy and Sonny Stitt and Sonny Rollins, things like that.
A lot of musician genes in your family.
